What is verified:
- docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md and docs/ARCHIVE_INDEX.md exist.
- Historical docs now point readers to the current-status truth surface.
- Claim extraction ignores command-name mentions, file-path mentions, risk lines,
  unverified lines, generated proof-strength report blocks, and explicit
  negative statements.
- Real completion and readiness language remains proof-bearing.
- Source-qualified test claims remain weak/provisional unless local command
  evidence exists.
- Wrong-repo command evidence remains blocked.
- Sidecar upgrade writes prompt-contract support and can generate local
  proof-surface candidates.
- Proof-surface discovery is local-only, deterministic, candidate-first, and
  does not approve repo-specific surfaces automatically.
- Sidecar next prompts can use approved or candidate proof-surface hints.
- The five-case operating-window smoke has zero critical misses.

What is weak/provisional:
- Repo proof-surface discovery v0 proposes candidates; it does not make them
  trusted proof contracts until approved.
- The static proof-surface packs are seed examples for known repos.
- The Canvas Helper run only verifies sidecar propagation and next-prompt
  generation; it does not certify the unrelated dirty Canvas worktree.

What is unverified:
- GitHub Actions status for this uncommitted STAX work.
- Whether the Canvas Helper sidecar candidate should be approved.
- Real-world rates beyond the current tests, fixtures, and smoke run.

Risks:
- STAX still has a large internal script and doc surface.
- Candidate proof surfaces can be incomplete on unusual repos.
- Attached-repo sidecar files should be reviewed before committing another repo.

One next action:
- Review this STAX diff and decide whether to commit the surgical operationalization pass.
